description_full:
SAIL INTERSHIP BATCH 12

Still looking for an internship to kick-start your career? This might be the opportunity you've been waiting for! 👀

SAIL Batch 12 is officially open for registration! 🚀

Join the Synergized Aquaculture Innovative Learning (SAIL) program and get the chance to gain hands on experience, develop your skills, and explore career opportunities in the aquaculture industry with PT Suri Tani Pemuka.

So, what are you waiting for? Your next learning experience could start here!

Let's SAIL with us! 🛳✨
